blocks.text:
Day 6 · Early pick-up at the hotel (approx. 7:20–8:20 am) for the Argentine side of the falls, one of the New Seven Wonders of Nature. The tour includes the three traditional circuits and the Ecological Jungle Train.
Lower Circuit · 1,700 metres of walkways venture into the jungle, close to the Dos Hermanas, Chico and Ramírez falls, down to the foot of the Salto Bossetti, with views of the Álvar Núñez, Elenita and Lanusse falls. Approx. 1 hour 45 minutes; medium difficulty; step-free access to the Bossetti fall and lookout balcony.
Upper Circuit · A 1,300-metre walk (round trip) on elevated walkways along the edge of several major falls, with an overview of the whole complex from above. Approx. 1 hour; easy, step-free.
Devil’s Throat · The Ecological Jungle Train takes you to Devil’s Throat Station, from where a 1,000-metre walkway leads to the grandiose Devil’s Throat, where the Iguazu shows all its strength.
